capabilities: Set a per-note default view mode via a frontmatter key
Switch the view automatically when a note is opened
Add or clear the view-mode key through commands
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.12.0 or later; no settings tab — all behavior is controlled per note.
problem: Obsidian applies a global view-mode default, so notes that should open in reading view (like a homepage) or editing view (like daily notes) require manual switching.
summary: Plugin that sets a per-note default view mode (reading or editing) via a frontmatter key and switches automatically when the note opens.
